\caption{\bt{One shared record through its lifecycle. Agent A learns \code{store\_revenue} $=$ \code{SUM(ss\_net\_paid)} over the grain (ss\_ticket\_number, ss\_item\_sk); the uniqueness check $c_1$ admits revision v1. Agent B reuses v1 for September without repeating the exploration. A restatement that keeps old rows duplicates a grain key: unmaintained reuse would still execute and return an over-counted answer, while \system\ blocks v1 before reuse. The filter \code{ss\_is\_current~$=$~1} becomes revision v2 only if it is the unique repair, preserves the key set, and reproduces the learning-time answer; otherwise the record is revoked.}{一条共享记录的生命周期。智能体 A 学习 \code{store\_revenue} $=$ \code{SUM(ss\_net\_paid)}，粒度为 (ss\_ticket\_number, ss\_item\_sk)；唯一性检查 $c_1$ 通过后发布 v1。智能体 B 为九月复用 v1，无须重复探索。更正保留旧行使同一粒度键重复：不维护的复用照常执行并返回偏高的答案，而 \system\ 在复用前阻止 v1。只有当过滤 \code{ss\_is\_current~$=$~1} 是唯一修复、保持键集合并重现学习时答案时，才发布为 v2；否则撤销该记录。}}
\label{fig:metric-record}
\Description{A record card for the metric store_revenue, the sum of ss_net_paid over the grain of ticket number and item key, with condition c1 requiring unique grain keys. Stage 1, learn: agent A answers a March question, the publication check passes, and revision v1 is published. Stage 2, reuse: agent B asks about September, the condition holds on the new snapshot, and SQL is produced without repeating schema inspection, value probes, or join tests. Stage 3, change: a restatement keeps old rows, the grain key (1001, 7) now has a current and an old row. Two fates follow: unmaintained reuse still executes and answers 8 to 15 percent too high, while MAVRA blocks v1 because the duplicated key violates the condition. Stage 4, maintain: the candidate filter ss_is_current = 1 must be the unique repair, preserve the key set, and reproduce the learning-time March answer; then v2 is published, otherwise the record is revoked.}
